d: The Spurs defeated the Pelicans, 114-91 tonight in San Antonio. Victor Wembanyama contributed a team-high 50 points to go with 19 rebounds 5 three pointers and 4 steals, with Stephon Castle of the Spurs adding an additional 19 points (7-12 FG, 5-7 3P) in the game. Jeremiah Fears finished with a team-high 29 points along with 5 rebounds for the Pelicans in the losing effort. The Spurs improve their record to 14-3 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 5-13 for the season.
